Catalog.title: Catalog Seeder
Catalog.subtitle: Populate and refresh the master product database from Chefaa's Meilisearch API — normalize, seed mappings, and reload the matcher index. No web scraping.
Catalog.refresh_chefaa_sub: Meilisearch API → Import → Normalize → Seed → Promote → Reload
Catalog.refresh_chefaa_desc: Fetches the Egyptian catalog via Chefaa's API (~30K products in minutes), normalizes all names, seeds mappings, and activates the catalog.
Catalog.test_pipeline_note: Test Pipeline runs the same steps but fetches only the specified number of products.
Catalog.note_renormalize: Use when the live catalog is already up to date but normalized names or brand mappings need to be rebuilt — e.g. after changing normalizer rules. Skips Meilisearch fetch; copies live → staging, re-normalizes, then promotes.
Catalog.note_reloadIndex: Use when SQLite already has the correct catalog but search/match still returns old data — e.g. after a manual DB edit, backend restart, or if promote finished but the matcher feels stale. Refreshes the in-memory index only; no crawl or promote.

HowItWorks.subtitle: Go behind the scenes of our high-performance matching engine. Learn how we transform inconsistent pharmacy data into perfectly mapped records with 99%+ accuracy.
HowItWorks.pipeline_subtitle: A 5-step technical walkthrough of the data transformation process.
HowItWorks.demo_subtitle: Test any query to see the real-time scoring breakdown and token mapping.
HowItWorks.breakdown_jaccard_desc: Measures token overlap and keyword importance.
HowItWorks.breakdown_sequence_desc: Measures character sequence similarity and typos.
HowItWorks.ready_desc: Type a product name on the left to see the AI analysis in action.
HowItWorks.blackbox_desc: Most AI systems are opaque. When they fail, you don't know why. PharmMatcher's "Turbo v9" engine is designed for transparency.
HowItWorks.blackbox_item1_desc: No random hallucinations. The scoring is based on fixed mathematical models.
HowItWorks.blackbox_item2_desc: By seeing why a match failed, you can improve your source data or add missing variants.
HowItWorks.blackbox_item3_desc: Every decision can be traced back to specific tokens and similarity metrics.
HowItWorks.cta_title: Ready to see it in action?
HowItWorks.cta_subtitle: Start matching your pharmacy catalog with the full power of Turbo v9.
HowItWorks.step_1_desc: We clean and standardize the raw product name. This involves converting Arabic to English, handling special characters, and normalizing units (e.g., '500 mg' vs '500mg').
HowItWorks.step_2_desc: The string is broken into meaningful tokens. We identify high-weight tokens like brands and doses, while filtering out low-information words like 'plus' or 'film coated'.
HowItWorks.step_3_desc: Instead of comparing with the whole database, we use an inverted index to instantly find products sharing at least one token with your query.
HowItWorks.step_4_desc: Candidates are scored using a dual-algorithm approach: Weighted Jaccard for token overlap (70%) and Sequence Matcher for literal string similarity (30%).
HowItWorks.step_5_desc: The engine applies final penalties or bonuses based on dose matches and brand exactness, selecting the highest confidence match for your data.
